assessments.resolution: Compile standalone Brief A. No amendment or inheritance source is required.
Retries after documented HTTP 500 failures are permitted, not required. Do not fabricate results or blindly retry an unknown write.
Make exactly one final close_call attempt. Do not retry it or claim successful closure without confirmation.
A definitively failed callback or transfer cannot truthfully receive its success outcome. No applicable failure outcome is supplied for the required close_call.
Brief A covers exactly one product. Empty or multiple-product responses violate that task domain; do not invent product selection.
Use Monday-based calendar weeks and the supplied now as local call time. Do not consult the real clock or invent a timezone conversion.
Past dates and above-full amounts are outside acceptable promise values; do not record them. Missing or inconsistent backend account data must not be fabricated.
Ask about today as required. If today is a weekend or holiday, offer the next business day before confirming or recording a promise.
The prescribed weekly date does not exceed either deadline within the stated domain. Never repeat a refused offer or invent an alternate persuasion offer.
Share the ordinary once-only floor offer across both triggers; preserve the explicit attempt-two permission. Clarify a vague proposal once, then propose the deadline.
Receive the response to the final permitted offer. Confirm an accepted promise; close refused if it is rejected without an actionable counterproposal.
Apply each stated trigger independently. A statement satisfying both counts toward both limits; no additional shared counter is required.
Handle a voluntary valid promise through confirmation and recording. An accepted support transfer may follow; its closing outcome takes precedence.
Hardship and post-promise transfer priorities are explicit. Other simultaneous terminal triggers can require incompatible outcomes without a supplied priority.
After recording, promise conflicts with later paid, dispute, hardship or refusal closing instructions. Only transfer precedence is explicit; the recorded promise remains unchanged.
Restrict disclosures to the opening information. Explicit availability questions, callback dialogue, condolences and farewell remain authorized.
Do not invent a retry ceiling. Swapped-date retries and unreadable inputs do not consume wrong-answer attempts; service errors do not establish verification.
Refer to customer service without supplying a number. State the returned amount without inventing a currency.
